limitations: Capture filters, dropped instrumentation and unrecorded requests are unknown. Absence is not zero execution or zero reuse.
QueryCacheHit instant records and QueryCacheHitCount integer values describe overlapping in-memory hits and must not be added.
IncrementalLoadResult intervals record disk-result loading, not all cross-session reuse or provider avoidance.
Repeated Query records for an invocation-local ID are candidates for investigation only, not proven redundant provider executions.
Matching graph fingerprints do not establish semantic dispensability, execution, cache eligibility, or sound reuse.
No nested wall spans are summed. Counts are not time saved, CPU work, execution span, or a theoretical maximum.

native_green_reuse.scope: Native proven-green route and provider-recompute branch only. Counts are invocations, not distinct query keys. Per-thread elapsed unions are not summed across threads or markers, CPU work, or removable time.

native_reexecution_results.scope: Retrospective result-hash classifications for re-executed existing keys only. Eval-always is separate. New keys are excluded; no_hash is unknown value equality. Same value does not prove changed inputs, avoidable execution, or prospective reuse. Marker durations are not provider durations.

optional_branch_inventory.scope: Optional native branch inventory only. Counts are branch entries, not query keys or avoided work. Per-thread elapsed unions are not summed across threads or markers and imply no CPU work, saved time, or critical path.
